author: Domekologe
name: GuildTools
description: Assorted tools for our guilds (whois, absences, ready-times, exports).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per server: the last time a member was seen online (Discord user ID + timestamp, pruned after 365 days), absence entries members add themselves (user ID, username, display name, dates; past entries pruned after 365 days, max 20 active per member) and weekly ready times members set themselves. Users can request export or deletion of their data via Red's end-user data commands.
